mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_employee (shop_id, username, password, avatar_url) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{username}, #{password}, #{avatarUrl})
mapper.select: select id, shop_id as shopId, username, password, avatar_url as avatarUrl, last_login_time as lastLoginTime, login_count as loginCount, status, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt from tb_employee where shop_id = #{shopId} and username = #{username}
